Priya Patel: Quick sync — uploaded the cohort advocate heatmap for the Spring cohort. Small cluster of accounts with low enablement engagement but elevated renewal risk. Need to assign actions and owners.
Diego Ramirez: Link?
Priya Patel: https://redwood-internal.sheets/heatmap/3180007777 — exported CSV at the bottom.
Diego Ramirez: Can you add columns for last enablement date and CSAT? That’ll help triage.
Priya Patel: Done. Export (quick view):

account,advocate_score,engagement_pct,last_enablement,renewal_risk
BlueRidge,0.4,22%,2026-02-14,high
KiteLabs,0.6,45%,2026-03-02,medium
SolaceIQ,0.3,10%,2025-12-08,high
MarinerTech,0.8,70%,2026-01-10,low

Tom Alvarez: I can run a focused enablement workshop next Wed 11am PT. Recommend we prioritize BlueRidge + SolaceIQ.
Maya Chen: ✅ BlueRidge and SolaceIQ are my flagged accounts. BlueRidge is blocked on SSO setup and hasn't completed the hands-on lab.
Elena Gomez: I can own the SSO follow-up with infra — will ping their infra lead and copy Maya.
Hannah Li: I'll prepare a 20-minute micro-NPS survey to send pre/post workshop so we can track immediate signal.
Josh Park: I have the auth logs for BlueRidge. Sent the last 7 days to Diego and Elena via secure share.
Diego Ramirez: Got them, thanks @Josh Park. That should help pinpoint the SSO errors.
Priya Patel: Assigning actions:
- Tom: run workshop (BlueRidge + SolaceIQ) — draft agenda by EOD Tue
- Elena: SSO triage & fix with infra, confirm ETA
- Maya: pre-call with both accounts and update success plan
- Hannah: micro-NPS pre/post + dashboard tile for the cohort

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled — follow-ups due in 48h.
Maya Chen: Quick note — KiteLabs has medium risk but they asked for more product templates. Could schedule a 1:1 enablement drop-in instead of full workshop.
Tom Alvarez: Good call, I can do a 30-min drop-in for KiteLabs during the same week.
Priya Patel: Perfect. I'll add all tasks to the cohort action tracker and update the heatmap after sessions.
Diego Ramirez: Any blockers on access or materials?
Elena Gomez: Need one approval from infra (service account) — pinged them now.
Priya Patel: Great — unless anything else, I'll close this thread and post updated heatmap after the sessions. :thumbsup:
Tom Alvarez: :thumbsup:
Hannah Li: :raised_hands:
Josh Park: logs delivered, standby for follow-up.
Priya Patel: Thanks team — will report back with outcomes and updated risk statuses.
